# Repository Instructions

- This solution contains a .NET 10 console application in `Fundamentals/`.
- Keep changes focused on the requested learning example and follow the existing C# style.
- Preserve nullable reference types and implicit usings as configured in `Fundamentals/Fundamentals.csproj`.
- Build the solution with `dotnet build Fundamentals.sln`.
- Run the application with `dotnet run --project Fundamentals/Fundamentals.csproj`.
- If a change adds or alters behavior, add or update focused tests when a test project is available; otherwise, verify by building and running the app.
